title: Vegetarian Enchilada Noodles
description: A flavorful and nutritious vegetarian dish that combines the comforting taste of enchiladas with the convenience of noodles.
instructions: Cook noodles according to package instructions.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add enchilada filling and cook until heated through.
Stir in enchilada sauce and bring to a simmer.
Add cooked noodles to the skillet and toss to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the noodle mixture to a serving dish.
Top with shredded cheese and chopped cilantro (if using).
Cover with aluminum foil and bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 15-20 minutes.
Remove foil and continue baking for an additional 5-10 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbly.
